IDBI Grade A Interview Result 2026 Out @idbi.bank.in

The IDBI Assistant Manager Result 2026 is out at idbi.bank.in for the personal interview round held for the recruitment of Assistant Manager- Grade A. The result contains the qualification status of the candidates and their next step details. Candidates are advised to download the result PDF and save it for the medical round.

IDBI Assistant Manager Interview Result 2026 Download PDF

The Industrial Development Bank of India has activated the IDBI Assistant Manager Result Link on the official website. Candidates can now check their interview results through idbi.bank.in. They need to visit the website and enter their registration number and date of birth to check their qualification status. Below we’ve provided the direct link of IDBI Grade A Interview Result 2026.

IDBI Assistant Manager Interview Result: Click to Download

How to Check IDBI Assistant Manager Interview Result 2026?

Candidates who appeared for the interview round can check their IDBI Assistant Manager Result 2026 by visiting the official IDBI website or using the direct result link given above. Follow these simple steps.

  1. Visit the official IDBI website at www.idbibank.in.
  2. Click on Careers then select Results of Various Recruitment Projects.
  3. Open the Recruitment of Assistant Manager- Grade A section.
  4. Click on the Results of Online Test link.
  5. Enter your Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  6. Click Submit to view your result.
  7. Download and save a copy of the result for future use.

What’s Next After IDBI Assistant Manager Grade A Interview Result?

Candidates who qualify in the IDBI Junior Assistant Manager interview exam will be called for next stage of the selection process i.e. Medical test. Those who clear the medical examination will be considered for final selection. The recruitment will fill 200 Assistant Manager posts across various IDBI Bank centres in India. Candidates should keep their documents ready and regularly check the official website for further updates.

Q3. Where can i check my IDBI Assistant Manager interview result?

Ans: Candidates can check the IDBI Assistant Manager Interview Result at idbi.bank.in
